properties.description: Adversaries may interrupt availability of system and network resources by inhibiting access to accounts utilized by legitimate users. Accounts may be deleted, locked, or manipulated (ex: changed credentials) to remove access to accounts. Sentinel UEBA detects anomalies based on dynamic baselines created for each entity across various data inputs. Anomalies can be triggered by the correlation of different attributes such as action type, geo-location, device, resource, ISP, and more.
